# Pierre Bayle

*1647 – 1706 · French*

A French Protestant who took refuge in Rotterdam, he published the *Nouvelles de la République des Lettres*, then a *Historical and Critical Dictionary* whose notes undermine every certainty. He defends toleration and argues that a society of atheists could be virtuous.
